title: Set up your archive
subtitle: Name it and create the super admin account, which manages the other admins and everything else.

code.label: Setup code
code.help: Printed in the server log, on the line that starts with [setup].

namesHelp: Shown in the header and on the home page. The logo, texts and colours can be changed later in Dashboard › Branding.

username.label: Super admin username
username.help: 3 to 32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.

passcode.label: Friends passcode
passcode.help: At least {min} characters. Friends of the team enter it to see private photos and videos. You can change it later.
